verdict.rationale: Event-triggered automation is a fair question for an online government filing and payment service, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows any user-definable rules that fire actions on events. The machine channels cited (MeF XML transmission and IRIS A2A intake) are credentialed submission rails, not event-driven rule automation, and probes found no API surface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
